claims.claim: Argentina has given Britain two weeks to halt planned oil drilling off the Falkland Islands.
claims.episode_span: Argentina gives Britain two weeks to halt Falklands drilling
claims.source_title: Argentina’s Milei declares war on Falklands oil with bizarre two-week ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: Argentina has given Britain two weeks to halt planned oil drilling off the Falkland Islands, escalating its long-running sovereignty dispute with the UK and threatening legal action under international maritime law.

claims.claim: President Javier Milei instructed Argentine government lawyers to begin proceedings under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea over the Sea Lion project in the North Falkland Basin.
claims.episode_span: instructed Argentine government lawyers to begin proceedings under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea
claims.source_title: Argentina’s Milei declares war on Falklands oil with bizarre two-week ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: President Javier Milei has instructed Argentine government lawyers to begin proceedings under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea over the planned Sea Lion project in the North Falkland Basin.

claims.claim: Milei described the project as illegitimate and accused Britain of plundering resources, while calling the islands the Malvinas.
claims.episode_span: called the project illegitimate and accused Britain of plundering resources
claims.source_title: Argentina’s Milei declares war on Falklands oil with bizarre two-week ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: Milei has described the project as “illegitimate” and accused Britain of “plundering our resources”, while continuing to refer to the islands by their Argentine name, the Malvinas.

claims.claim: Navitas Petroleum is leading the Sea Lion development, with Rockhopper Exploration as a minority partner, and drilling is expected early next year subject to UK Foreign Secretary approval.
claims.episode_span: Navitas Petroleum is leading the development, with UK-listed Rockhopper Exploration
claims.source_title: Argentina’s Milei declares war on Falklands oil with bizarre two-week ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: The development is being led by Israeli energy company Navitas Petroleum, with UK-listed Rockhopper Exploration as a minority partner. Drilling is expected to begin early next year, subject to approval from the UK Foreign Secretary .

claims.claim: Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno said Britain had been formally notified that arbitration was being initiated and that unauthorized exploration must face consequences, while Argentina acts by peaceful means under international law.
claims.episode_span: Britain had been formally notified that an arbitration process was being initiated
claims.source_title: Argentina’s Milei declares war on Falklands oil with bizarre two-week ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno confirmed that Britain had been formally notified that an arbitration process was being initiated.

claims.claim: Brazil’s Electoral Justice received 51,395 complaints of irregular propaganda through the Pardal app.
claims.episode_span: received 51,395 complaints of irregular propaganda through Pardal
claims.source_title: Brazil’s Electoral Justice Receives 51,395 Complaints of Irregular Propaganda
claims.supporting_quote: The reports were made through Pardal, an electronic application created by the court to receive complaints related to possible irregularities.

claims.claim: São Paulo had 10,388 complaints, Bahia 5,969, Minas Gerais 4,635 and Pernambuco 3,505.
claims.episode_span: São Paulo accounts for 10,388, followed by Bahia with 5,969
claims.source_title: Brazil’s Electoral Justice Receives 51,395 Complaints of Irregular Propaganda
claims.supporting_quote: São Paulo accounts for the highest number of incidents with 10,388, followed by Bahia (5,969), Minas Gerais (4,635) and Pernambuco (3,505).

claims.claim: Irregular propaganda on public roads made up 43.78 percent of complaints, and 27 percent of complaints had been converted into cases.
claims.episode_span: 43.78 percent of complaints received so far
claims.source_title: Brazil’s Electoral Justice Receives 51,395 Complaints of Irregular Propaganda
claims.supporting_quote: The main category of complaints is irregular propaganda or propaganda outside established standards on public roads, representing 43.78% of the total received so far.

claims.claim: Brazil’s first round is scheduled for October 4, with a possible second round three weeks later, and voters will choose president, vice president, governors, 54 of 81 senators and deputies.
claims.episode_span: The first round is scheduled for October 4
claims.source_title: Brazil’s Electoral Justice Receives 51,395 Complaints of Irregular Propaganda
claims.supporting_quote: In the Brazilian elections, with the first round scheduled for October 4 and, if necessary, the second three weeks later, president, vice president, governors, 54 of 81 senators and federal, state and district deputies will be chosen.

claims.claim: Hurricane Polo made landfall just south of Las Barrancas in Baja California Sur with maximum sustained winds of 110 mph, according to Mexican officials.
claims.episode_span: made landfall just south of Las Barrancas, in Baja California Sur
claims.source_title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
claims.supporting_quote: Mexican officials said Polo moved ashore just south of the surfing and fishing village of Las Barrancas bringing maximum sustained winds of 110 mph (175 km/h).

claims.claim: Polo was forecast to cross Baja California Sur and move inland over southern Sonora later on Tuesday, and the National Hurricane Center said it could still be a hurricane at a second landfall on mainland Mexico.
claims.episode_span: moving inland over southern Sonora later on Tuesday
claims.source_title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
claims.supporting_quote: The US-based National Hurricane Center (NHC) said that while Polo was expected to weaken as it moved over the Baja California peninsula, it was forecast to still be at hurricane strength when it makes its second landfall in mainland Mexico.

claims.claim: Meteorologists said Polo could dump 6 to 12 inches of rain, and the National Hurricane Center warned of storm surge and destructive waves.
claims.episode_span: could drop 6 to 12 inches of rain
claims.source_title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
claims.supporting_quote: Meteorologists said Polo could dump between 6 and 12 inches (150-300mm) of rain across parts of Baja California Sur, which they warned could produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain.

claims.claim: María Palomino, 57, told AFP she spent the night in a high school used as a shelter.
claims.episode_span: María Palomino, 57, told AFP she spent the night in a high school
claims.source_title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
claims.supporting_quote: Shopkeeper María Palomino, 57, spent the night at a high school which has been turned into a temporary shelter.

claims.claim: Decree 1116/2026, signed by Javier Milei and Pablo Quirno, named Adolfo Cambiaso ad honorem as an extraordinary and plenipotentiary ambassador to promote Argentine sport, especially polo.
claims.episode_span: Decree 1116/2026 naming polo player Adolfo Cambiaso
claims.source_title: El Gobierno nombró a Adolfo Cambiaso como embajador extraordinario de la Argentina
claims.supporting_quote: El Gobierno declaró este martes al polista Adolfo Cambiaso como “representante para la promoción internacional del deporte argentino”, a través del Decreto 1116/2026 , publicado en el Boletín Oficial

claims.claim: Máximo Kirchner and Cristian Ritondo top Argentina’s Chamber of Deputies asset ranking with fortunes above 10 billion pesos.
claims.episode_span: Máximo Kirchner and Cristian Ritondo top the asset-declaration ranking
claims.source_title: Argentina's richest lawmakers – what their asset declarations reveal
claims.supporting_quote: Máximo Kirchner, the son of ex-president Cristina Fernández de Kirchner and PRO veteran cum government ally Cristian Ritondo top the ranking of rich lawmakers, with fortunes above 10 billion pesos.

claims.claim: The Oxford English Dictionary added the words bimpert, douen and canboulay.
claims.episode_span: added the Caribbean words bimpert, douen and canboulay
claims.source_title: ‘Bimpert,’ ‘douen’ and ‘canboulay’ are the newest adds to the Oxford English Dictionary
claims.supporting_quote: ‘Bimpert,’ ‘douen’ and ‘canboulay’ are the newest adds to the Oxford English Dictionary

claims.claim: Brazilians again received more than one hundred Portuguese golden visas, and with property purchases barred the money went into investments.
claims.episode_span: topped one hundred grants of Portugal’s golden visas
claims.source_title: Portugal volta a conceder mais vistos gold para brasileiros
claims.supporting_quote: Os brasileiros voltaram a superar uma centena de concessões dos polêmicos vistos gold em Portugal. Com o veto sobre a compra de imóveis, o dinheiro foi direcionado para investimentos.

claims.claim: Delcy Rodríguez, described as Venezuela’s interim president, met Donald Trump for fifteen minutes at the United Nations, and Nicolás Maduro is in a Brooklyn jail awaiting trial on drug-trafficking and narcoterrorism charges, according to Daniel DePetris.
claims.episode_span: met President Donald Trump for fifteen minutes
claims.source_title: Daniel DePetris: Venezuela has bent to US will. Is that good for Venezuelans?
claims.supporting_quote: On stage was Delcy Rodríguez, Venezuela’s interim president, addressing the United Nations General Assembly and meeting with President Donald Trump less than a year after both considered her somewhat of a pariah.

claims.claim: DePetris writes that Venezuela has reopened oil, gold and mineral industries to foreign companies under US pressure, which he also calls modern-day colonialism.
claims.episode_span: reopen its oil, gold and mineral industries to foreign companies
claims.source_title: Daniel DePetris: Venezuela has bent to US will. Is that good for Venezuelans?
claims.supporting_quote: By using the carrot of U.S. investment and the stick of U.S. coercion, the Venezuelan government has been pushed into enacting policies — such as reopening the country’s oil, gold and mineral industries to foreign companies — that likely would have Chávez rolling in his grave.

claims.claim: Colégio Salesiano Santa Rosa’s girls’ handball team, representing Rio de Janeiro, beat Amazonas 29-20 in the quarterfinal of the Brazilian School Games in Brasília and advanced to the semifinal.
claims.episode_span: beat Amazonas 29-20 in the quarterfinal and advanced to the semifinal
claims.source_title: Alunos-atletas levam o nome de Niterói para competições esportivas
claims.supporting_quote: Nas quartas de final, quinta-feira, as meninas venceram o Amazonas por 29 a 20 e avançaram à semifinal, anteontem, contra Mato Grosso.
